links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM chatbots on colorectal cancer guideline MCQs under zero-shot constrained prompting
links.effect: Overall accuracy was low: Kimi K2 Thinking 27.74%, Claude Opus 4.5 26.28%, Gemini 3 Pro 16.06%, DeepSeek V3.2 15.33%, GPT-5.1 14.60%, Qwen3-Max 13.87%.
links.quote: Overall accuracy was low: Kimi K2 Thinking 27.74%, SD = 0.45, Claude Opus 4.5 26.28%, SD = 0.44, Gemini 3 Pro 16.06%, SD = 0.37, DeepSeek V3.2 15.33%, SD = 0.36, GPT-5.1 14.60%, SD = 0.35, and Qwen3-Max 13.87%, SD = 0.34.

links.outcome: LLM clinical knowledge accuracy against current colorectal cancer guidelines
links.effect: Accuracy 13.87%-27.74% on 137 guideline-based MCQs; four failure patterns including fact retrieval error and hallucinations; module-wise disparities (Kimi 37.04% vs Qwen3-Max 7.41% in Endoscopic Imaging).
links.quote: Qualitative analysis revealed four failure patterns: semantic association bias, hierarchical logic failure, fact retrieval error, and hallucinations.

unlisted_practices: Chain-of-thought prompting to improve LLM clinical question accuracy
Domain-specific fine-tuning of LLMs for oncology

screen.reason: Evaluates the benchmark accuracy and error patterns of multiple next-generation LLMs on a set of colorectal cancer MCQs without testing a deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
